required_contract: Require one valid bucket and bind its exact value into the signed object ACL target.
Require one valid object key and preserve its exact greedy-path encoding.
Preserve omission or one exact bounded generation selector in the signed query.
Preserve omission or the sole exact requester value as a signed header.
Preserve omission or one bounded control-free owner precondition exactly once.
Preserve optional Owner structure presence and exact child strings.
Preserve optional AccessControlList presence and ordered nonflattened Grant values.
Preserve omission or the sole exact requester response value.
Preserve omission or exact owner display name including empty text.
Preserve omission or exact owner canonical identifier including empty text.
Preserve optional grantee structure and require its exact xsi:type attribute when present.
Preserve optional exact permission without inventing an authorization default.
Preserve omission or exact grantee display name including empty text.
Preserve omission or exact grantee email address including empty text.
Preserve omission or exact grantee canonical identifier including empty text.
Require exactly one xsi:type attribute from the three-value pinned grantee domain.
Preserve omission or exact grantee group URI including empty text.
